tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6db9ff3afbd908bf7fdc.html
